title: HELIX AcademicTermRecord Resource
description: A student's academic summary for a single academic period: term GPA, cumulative GPA, units attempted/earned, academic standing, and enrollment status. One record per student per period.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this term record.

student_ref.description: Reference to the HELIX Student resource.

period_ref.description: Reference to the HELIX AcademicPeriod resource.

academic_level.description: Academic level as of this period.

units_passed.description: Credit hours with passing grade (may differ from earned if institution distinguishes).

quality_points.description: Total quality points this period (grade points × credit hours per course).

cumulative_gpa.description: Running cumulative GPA through this period.

cumulative_units_earned.description: Total earned units through this period (all terms).

cumulative_units_attempted.description: Total attempted units through this period.

dean_list.description: Whether the student made the Dean's List this period.

academic_load.description: Official academic load classification (drives financial aid eligibility).
